_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Sluice/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, the controller [0,0,0]: the head cell, nearest the player; the sluice runs south from it, three blocks. Nothing moves: no power cell, no work, no driver. infeedCell/infeedFace: a vanilla chute from above meets the infeed section; waterCell/waterFace: a ppex pipe meets the water inlet; tailingsCell/tailingsFace: the tailings chute leaves the tail. feedSpout is where the ore falls into the head box, waterSpout the nozzle's mouth, concentrate the middle of the riffles (clean-up). fill lists the concentrate's states, emptiest first: one is drawn at a time, or none. See the sluice's README for the schema.

fill._comment: The concentrate held behind the riffles, one state drawn at a time by how full they are: concentrate1 the head pockets part full, concentrate2 most of them, concentrate3 every pocket brimming (full: the sluice passes everything on until it is cleaned up).
